goal: 20 additional v2 high-quality One Life Relay stages

stages.title: 빙하 열선
stages.description: 달궈진 열선으로 빙하를 자르되 끊어지지 않게 당기세요.
stages.mechanic: Close-up glacier face. A glowing wire spans two handles. Drag to set tension, hold to heat. Cut along marked seams. Too much heat melts through (fail). Too much tension snaps. Camera on the ice wall.

stages.title: 바람 하프
stages.description: 바람이 밝히는 현만 뜯어 협곡 하프를 연주하세요.
stages.mechanic: Giant canyon harp, 5 strings. Wind gusts light one string at a time (telegraph glow 0.6s). Pluck only the lit string. Camera looking along the harp toward the gorge.

stages.title: 버섯 구름
stages.description: 버섯 갓을 튕기며 포자를 모으세요.
stages.mechanic: Auto-bounce on mushroom caps in a misty grove. Steer landing. Purple caps poison. Spores hover above gold caps. Camera behind-above.

stages.title: 구리 나선
stages.description: 심선에 구리선을 감아 코일을 완성하세요.
stages.mechanic: Workshop close-up. Core spins. Drag to match winding speed, tap to press the wire flush. Overlap or gap = short. Camera locked on the coil.

stages.title: 안개 부표
stages.description: 경적으로 안개를 가르며 부표를 지나세요.
stages.mechanic: Small boat in dense fog. Horn blast parts fog in a cone for 1.2s revealing buoys and rocks. Steer through. Camera behind the bow.

stages.title: 덩굴 전환
stages.description: 짚라인을 바꿔 타며 밀림 캐노피를 가로지르세요.
stages.mechanic: Auto-travel along a vine. Upcoming forks glow. Tap at the junction to switch. Missed switch dumps into canopy void. Chase camera through leaves.

stages.title: 보일러 압력
stages.description: 밸브를 열어 압력을 초록 구간에 유지하세요.
stages.mechanic: Engine room. Pressure needle drifts. 4 valves add/vent steam. A sequence of 5 target bands appears. Hit each band then lock. Blow or flameout fails. Close 3D boiler camera.

stages.title: 눈사태 썰매
stages.description: 눈을 가르며 전나무를 피해 산장까지 내려가세요.
stages.mechanic: Forward auto-sled down a slope. Lean to dodge pines and rocks. Powder spray, chase camera. Telegraph shadows of upcoming trees.

stages.title: 다시마 문
stages.description: 닫히는 다시마 사이로 헤엄쳐 통과하세요.
stages.mechanic: Underwater kelp forest. Gates of kelp open then slam. Swim through openings. Distinct from reef-sub (no ballast rings). Follow camera in green fog.

stages.title: 운석 모루
stages.description: 떨어지는 운석을 받아 빛나는 순간에 내려치세요.
stages.failCondition: 놓침 4회 또는 식은 타격 시 실패
stages.mechanic: Night observatory courtyard. Meteors fall with trails. Catch on anvil then strike while gold-hot. Distinct from comet-net (catch-only) and forge-strike (no falling catch). Camera 3/4 above courtyard.

stages.title: 굴뚝 청소
stages.description: 그을음을 쓸며 굴뚝 꼭대기까지 오르세요.
stages.controls: 좌우 이동, 탭으로 점프, 홀드로 솔질
stages.mechanic: Inside a giant brick chimney. Climb ledges. Soot clouds drift; hold to sweep them. Unswept cloud = choke. Camera inside looking up.

stages.title: 도르래 절벽
stages.description: 도르래를 바꿔 가며 절벽 위로 몸을 끌어올리세요.
stages.mechanic: Cliff face with 3 pulley lines. Hold to haul. Lines fatigue; tap to switch before snap. Distinct from pendulum-spire (no swinging clock). Side-3/4 camera on the cliff.

stages.title: 빗물 수조
stages.description: 지붕을 기울여 빗물을 수조에 모으세요.
stages.mechanic: Village roofs. Rain falls in sheets. Tilt panels to channel into a central cistern. Overflow gutters fail if overfilled too fast. Elevated isometric 3D.

stages.title: 올빼미 비행
stages.description: 달빛만 밟으며 쥐를 잡고 마을을 깨우지 마세요.
stages.mechanic: Night village. Stay in moonlight columns (quiet). Trees and roofs are noisy. Dive to catch mice in fields. Noise meter. Distinct from solstice-glider and owl is predator not hang-glider. Camera behind owl.

stages.title: 거미줄 보행
stages.description: 진동을 죽이며 거미줄 중심으로 걸어가세요.
stages.mechanic: Giant dew-lit web. Walking adds vibration. Hold to damp. Too much vibration snaps a strand. Camera slightly above the web looking to the hub.

stages.title: 지맥 나침반
stages.description: 고리를 돌려 지맥 네 줄을 맞추세요.
stages.mechanic: Standing stones, 3 nested compass rings. Align glowing ley lines through the center. Misalign too long overloads. Distinct from sun-mirrors (no sun beam temple). Elevated stone circle camera.

stages.title: 별 주형
stages.description: 녹은 별빛을 틀에 부어 식을 때까지 기울기를 잡으세요.
stages.mechanic: Celestial foundry. Tilt a crucible of starlight into a star-shaped mold. Too steep spills. Too slow freezes in the spout. Close studio camera, molten light materials.

stages.title: 메아리 다리
stages.description: 외침으로 얼음 다리를 잠깐 얼려 협곡을 건너세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT sonar moth hunting. Shout freezes a mist bridge for ~1.4s. Run across before it thaws. Multiple gaps. Camera behind on the canyon rim.

stages.title: 체 보석
stages.description: 체를 흔들어 모래는 빼고 보석만 남기세요.
stages.mechanic: Desert camp. Shake a sieve. Sand falls through; gems must stay then be tipped into a pouch with a gentle tilt. Too violent dumps gems. Close 3D.

stages.title: 풀무 심장
stages.description: 풀무를 눌러 화로 심장을 적당한 불로 유지하세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT ingot-color striking. A living forge heart pulses. Pump bellows on the beat to keep a heat band. Sparks telegraph the next beat. Camera on the heart and bellows.
